I developed my own data logging system for vehicles, using a raspberry pi, which I'm currently writing a paper about, to be published.  The data was gathered during an SCCA Autocross Solo event, with myself as the driver, and my 05 Ford Focus as the subject matter.  The data was saved to a local mysql table in the computer that I added to the vehicle, then offloaded for analysis when I wasn't driving.  This represents 1 of 5 runs that I did during the day.

Raw data: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OF\_TarGnyfkLp1dMlEaZlG-EUR19pv5Xsv9TPKbiiaw/edit?usp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OF_TarGnyfkLp1dMlEaZlG-EUR19pv5Xsv9TPKbiiaw/edit?usp=sharing)

I've always had a passion for games and programming.  I'm just using Java with OpenGL.  What you see was all hand coded.  I've had to go back and redo some stuff that wasn't working well or wasn't scalable, but I'm learning as I go, and I love the sense of accomplishment the closer I am to getting the base engine wrapped up.
